messages:
jess: FYI — onboarding jobs for several trial tenants hit a high-rate throttle earlier and some embedding batches failed. Need a short customer-facing status + office hours invite. Who can draft?

mike: I can take the first draft. quick Q: do we confirm affected tenants list?

jess: yes — ops exported a list, attaching link in the support ticket. Main ask: status, ETA for re-ingest, credits, and an invite to a live troubleshooting office hours. Keep it concise.

ops-bot: export complete: 27 tenants affected; peak throttle window 2024-11-04T02:14:00Z - 2024-11-04T02:42:00Z.

tara: Thanks — I started a short template below we can reuse across accounts:  

-- message start --
Hi <Account Team>,
We’re reaching out to let you know we experienced a transient ingestion throttling event that impacted embedding batches for onboarding activity between 02:14–02:42 UTC. Our engineers resolved the throttling configuration and requeued failed batches.
What we’re doing: re-ingesting affected batches (ETA 6–8 hours), providing a courtesy credit for reingestion token usage, and hosting a 1-hr live office hours for any customers that want hands-on help.
Office hours: Today 16:00 UTC — join: https://zoom.redwood.example/officehours
We’ll follow up with an RCA and per-account remediation notes within 24 hours.
-- message end --

mike: Nice. Two edits: call out which API (embeddings ingest API) and include a short mitigation steps list so customers know what to expect.

kevin: Heads up — for some dedicated tenants we can prioritize requeue order; I’ll add a label for urgency so CS can pick customers to escalate.

jess: Good — mike, can you update template and post as the initial outbound? Tara + Kevin will create per-account notes.

mike: Posted outbound to affected tenants (using template + urgency tags). Also added these bullets in message:  
- What you can expect: successful re-ingest or manual retry option; no schema changes required.
- If you want priority reprocessing, reply to this thread with "priority: yes" and we’ll bump you in the queue.

cs-bot: Outreach queued: 27 messages scheduled, rate-limited to 5/min to avoid additional load.

jess: Great. Next: RCA summary for customers (short): cause, mitigation, owner, and permanent next steps. Kevin — can you add a one-line cause + permanent fix ETA?

kevin: Cause (one-line): misconfigured rate window on a shard routing rule that undercounted steady-state tokens under concurrent onboarding ingestion. Permanent fix: deploy routing guard + improved shard telemetry; ETA 3 business days. Owner: eng-infra (kevin).

mike: I’ll add that to the customer RCA follow-up. Also adding a quick feedback capture link in the email for account teams to surface regression worries.

mike: Drafted follow-up RCA email (short):
"We found a shard routing misconfiguration that caused temporary token undercounting under concurrent uploads. We’ve applied an immediate config fix, reprocessed affected batches, and plan a durable routing guard within 3 business days. We apologize for the disruption and will issue a credit for re-ingest usage. If you’d like a walkthrough, please join the office hours or reply to this message."

jess: Perfect. Who will run the office hours? Tara?

tara: Yep I’ll host. Can one of you create a short runbook/slide deck I can share during the session? 10–12 min + Q&A.

mike: I’ll create 5 slides: incident timeline, what we fixed, how we’re prioritizing, re-ingest instructions.

jess: Action items:  
- mike: send outbound and RCA follow-up (done)
- tara: host office hours & share deck (in progress)
- kevin: confirm per-account priority labels and permanent fix ETA (in progress)
- cs-bot: log credits issued after reprocess completes (pending)

cs-bot: Reminder: please add account-specific comments to ticket #CS-4221 so renewals and AMs see where there might be churn risk.

jess: Also flag any accounts with renewal windows in next 30 days — we’ll offer direct enablement and an exec note if needed.

mike: Noted. I’ll add a filtered view for renewals and push to AMs.

kevin: Will post an engineering status update in eng-oncall channel once the permanent guard is deployed.

jess: Thanks team — keep updates to this thread for auditability. I’ll compile a short exec summary after office hours and we’ll include the feedback we collect. :thumbsup:
